items.title: 3 AI Stocks With Revenue Growth Up To 42%
items.summary: The Federal Reserve just lifted interest rates again, putting more pressure on debt-heavy sectors while capital keeps flowing toward artificial intelligence. That split matters. Cash hungry software ideas can struggle when money costs more, but the physical backbone of AI, from specialized power to high density data centers, can still capture real spending. This article highlights three infrastructure stocks linked to AI that fit that theme. The companies below are just a starting sample of...

items.title: Why Is Vertiv Stock Up Sharply Over The Past Year Yet Well Below Its Peak?
items.summary: Vertiv (VRT) stock gained 75.9% over the past year, more than four times the S&P 500's 16.7% return. The company sells the power and cooling equipment that AI data centers depend on, and its sales and margins have grown fast. Yet the shares sit about a third below their 52-week high. The question analysts keep raising is delivery.
